u0: Initial phase: the blocking ball has not yet been moved away from the door, so the key-after-ball requirement has not been triggered. The agent may or may not already hold the matching door key. Next objective: move the ball away from the door and ensure the matching key is held either then or later; if the ball is moved while the key is not held, the machine enters the recoverable u1 state.
u1: Recoverable violation phase: the ball has been moved away at least once without the matching door key being held, and the agent is not currently carrying that key. The requirement is still repairable: free the hands if needed, keeping the ball away from the door, and pick up the key matching the door. Holding that key next transitions to terminal success u2; this state can persist even if the ball is later dropped back in front of the door, because the obligation was already incurred.
u2: Terminal success state: the required condition is satisfied—the ball was moved away and the matching door key has been held either at that point or afterward. No further reward-machine progress is needed; all later transitions remain here, even if the key is later dropped or the ball is returned to the door cell. If continuing the underlying MiniGrid mission, the remaining environment objective is to open the door and pick up the designated target box.
